inputs.devices: All 350000 main signatures in measurements/signing; no pilots or stage records

pooling.44: 150000 signatures, ESP32 and both RP2040 units

quantiles.estimator: Smallest K whose cumulative count is at least ceil(N*p), using exact rational ranks

key_bootstrap.unit: Shared key identity within a parameter set; keep all its boards, messages and boot blocks together
key_bootstrap.resample: Draw 10 keys independently with replacement from the 10 observed identities; retain every record in each selected key, with multiplicity
key_bootstrap.evaluation: Enumerate all 92378 nonnegative multiplicity vectors w with sum(w)=10
key_bootstrap.weight: 10!/(product(w_i!)*10^10); integer numerator counts ordered key resamples
key_bootstrap.interval: Pointwise equal-tailed percentile interval: inverse bootstrap CDF at 0.025 and 0.975; no interpolation
key_bootstrap.se: Standard deviation of the exact conditional bootstrap distribution, not Monte Carlo standard error

ordinary_bootstrap.unit: Individual signatures within source and set
ordinary_bootstrap.evaluation: For rank r=ceil(N*p), the bootstrap quantile CDF at integer k is Pr[Binomial(N,F_empirical(k)) >= r]
ordinary_bootstrap.interval: Pointwise inverse bootstrap CDF at 0.025 and 0.975; no interpolation
ordinary_bootstrap.se: Standard deviation computed from successive CDF differences
ordinary_bootstrap.role: Sensitivity comparison; device primary intervals use shared-key clusters

interpretation: All 9 device point quantiles equal the corrected references, and all 9 pointwise key-bootstrap intervals contain them. Coverage is conditional on the observed keys and board/message/boot design. A zero-width interval reflects a concentrated discrete bootstrap distribution and does not establish zero population uncertainty. Host and device inputs are not paired; their comparison does not isolate hardware from workload or build differences. These quantiles do not measure rare-event probabilities such as 10^-9.
measurement_integrity: All 41 measurement files are unchanged from version 1.0.0.
